title: Olvar telemetry v1 (firmware output)
description: Payload the ESP32 publishes to olvar/v1/<device_id>/telemetry (QoS 1, not retained, every 60 s). Describes exactly what the firmware emits; consumers should still ignore unknown keys. See docs/PLAN.md §4.1. Dedup key is (device_id, boot_id, seq). NaN/Infinity are never sent.

device_id.description: Gateway rule; 'olvar-gateway' is reserved. Equals the topic segment, MQTT client id and username. The extra 'not' pattern rejects a trailing newline, which Python's '$' would otherwise accept.

boot_id.description: 8 lowercase hex chars, random per boot.

seq.description: 0 at boot, +1 per message handed to the MQTT client; never reused within a boot_id. Gaps possible.

temperature_c.description: From the sensor named by climate_sensor, 2 dp; null on read/CRC failure.

humidity_pct.description: From the sensor named by climate_sensor, 2 dp; null on read/CRC failure.

soil_raw.description: 12-bit ADC count at 11 dB, trimmed mean of 64 samples; higher = drier; null if sampling fails. No soil_pct is sent.

climate_sensor.description: The temperature/humidity sensor the firmware is reading: sht31 (I2C 0x44/0x45) or dht11 (GPIO4). Optional: omitted (never null) while no climate sensor has been detected. Consumers must treat unknown values as absent, never reject the message for them.

rssi_dbm.description: Wi-Fi RSSI. Optional: omitted (never null) when not connected.

fw.description: SemVer + git short hash, e.g. 0.1.0+a1b2c3d (bare SemVer when built without git).
